mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_baby_info (email, baby_name, birth_date, gender, profile_image_file_name, blood_type, birth_week_count, birth_weight, birth_height, head_circumference) VALUES (#{email}, #{babyInfo.babyName}, #{babyInfo.birthDate}, #{babyInfo.gender}, #{babyInfo.profileImageFileName}, #{babyInfo.bloodType}, #{babyInfo.birthWeekCount}, #{babyInfo.birthWeight}, #{babyInfo.birthHeight}, #{babyInfo.headCircumference})
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_baby_info SET baby_name = #{babyInfo.babyName}, birth_date = #{babyInfo.birthDate}, gender = #{babyInfo.gender}, profile_image_file_name = #{babyInfo.profileImageFileName}, blood_type = #{babyInfo.bloodType}, birth_week_count = #{babyInfo.birthWeekCount}, birth_weight = #{babyInfo.birthWeight}, birth_height = #{babyInfo.birthHeight}, head_circumference = #{babyInfo.headCircumference} WHERE baby_no = #{babyInfo.babyNo} AND email = #{email}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tbl_baby_info WHERE baby_no = #{babyNo} AND email = #{email}

DELETE bi, bg, bv, bs, bd, ba, po, poi, bc, bcs, bcm, bcsrc, cta, ac, rr, sc, skc, cc FROM tbl_baby_info bi LEFT JOIN tbl_baby_grow_info bg ON bg.baby_no = bi.baby_no LEFT JOIN tbl_baby_vaccination bv ON bv.baby_no = bi.baby_no LEFT JOIN tbl_baby_sleep bs ON bs.baby_no = bi.baby_no LEFT JOIN tbl_baby_diary bd ON bd.baby_no = bi.baby_no LEFT JOIN tbl_baby_album ba ON ba.baby_no = bi.baby_no LEFT JOIN tbl_print_order po ON po.baby_no = bi.baby_no LEFT JOIN tbl_print_order_item poi ON poi.order_no = po.order_no LEFT JOIN tbl_baby_behavior_consult bc ON bc.baby_no = bi.baby_no LEFT JOIN tbl_baby_behavior_step bcs ON bcs.consult_no = bc.consult_no LEFT JOIN tbl_baby_behavior_message bcm ON bcm.consult_no = bc.consult_no LEFT JOIN tbl_baby_behavior_source bcsrc ON bcsrc.consult_no = bc.consult_no LEFT JOIN tbl_baby_custom_allergy cta ON cta.babyNo = bi.baby_no LEFT JOIN tbl_baby_allergy_check ac ON ac.babyNo = bi.baby_no LEFT JOIN tbl_recipe_recommend rr ON rr.checkNo = ac.checkNo LEFT JOIN tbl_baby_stool_check sc ON sc.babyNo = bi.baby_no LEFT JOIN tbl_baby_skin_check skc ON skc.babyNo = bi.baby_no LEFT JOIN tbl_cry_check cc ON cc.baby_no = bi.baby_no WHERE bi.baby_no = #{babyNo} AND bi.email = #{email}
